title: The eye (View Permissions) icon shows in the Actions column only for Office User and Time Clock User
preconds: 1. You are logged in as an admin on Settings > Roles & Permissions.
steps:
1. Open Settings > Roles & Permissions.
  2. Look at the Actions column for the Office User and Time Clock User rows.
  3. Look at the Actions column for the other roles.
  4. On one other role, open the three-dot menu and look at the options.
expected:
A standalone eye icon appears in the Actions column only for Office User and Time Clock User (the non-editable roles).

Every other role has no standalone eye icon; those rows reach View Permissions through the three-dot menu.
